title.narrative: Project for Learning Upgrade Support and Decentralization

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve the foundational literacy and numeracy of primary education learners, as well as the learning outcomes in reading and mathematics of lower secondary education learners in public schools nationwide.

The proposed Project would support the implementation of selected Department of Education (DepEd)'s programs aimed to improve the quality of public elementary and lower secondary education (junior high school) nationwide. It would support DepEd's education reform agenda including decentralization programs. By the end of the implementation of the proposed Project, it is expected that Philippines' learners would perform better in national and international assessments of learning outcomes than currently observed, as well as learning gaps of K-6 learners would be addressed. The proposed Project would finance activities that would be implemented according to both centralized and decentralized implementation arrangements. It would be structured around clusters of system-level interventions (or activities), targeted interventions, as well as activities on monitoring and evaluation of the proposed interventions. The system-level interventions to be financed through the proposed Project would include: (a) implementation of learning acceleration or recovery programs; (b) evidence-based support to the continuous professional development of teachers, including those of the Alternative Learning System; (c) improvement of assessments of learning outcomes; (d) improvement of teaching and learning conditions; and (e) support to the teaching and learning of learners with disabilities. The targeted interventions would be implemented according to decentralized arrangements by selected regional offices of DepEd and their schools, and would include activities such as: (a) capacity enhancement; (b) tailored support to teachers including through school-level training; (c) provision of specific teaching and learning resources to schools; and (d) tailored support to learning acceleration or recovery at the school level. The proposed Project will not finance construction, renovation or rehabilitation of schools or classrooms. It would be implemented over six years starting in 2026.
